gen-dafont-groovy-fs-epilogue: Epilogue reads soft and curvy, with a wire-thin line throughout. Groovy nearly seals its c into a narrow slit and tracks loosely, so the friendly funk sits against that open, unclamped body.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-fs-asap: Love Ya Like A Sister keeps its ascenders barely above the x-height. That heading does bold, outward-pointing shapes best, while Asap does readable sans text, its open-arc c forms sitting nearly as tall as capitals.
gen-dafont-groovy-fs-supreme: Funky and loose, Groovy nearly seals its c into a slit, with every stroke ending at one measured thickness. Supreme counters with crisp, heavy-looking text, its letters held open.
gen-gf-grandstander-fs-epilogue: Bold Grandstander draws plain constant-width lines with short ascenders and a tall x-height, held open rather than curled shut. Epilogue adds curvy, unclamped ease through a wire-like monoline stroke.
gen-gf-revalia-manrope: Manrope keeps a bright open gap at every curve's mouth and a minimal step from capitals to lowercase. Revalia's tall, widely spaced letters supply the bold, expressive punch above it.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-montserrat: Stencil-cut and tall, Snowburst One leaves wide bridges between its letters and a wide-sprung opening, bold throughout. Montserrat glides beneath like wire, curves full of oversized, open counters.
gen-gf-underdog-fs-bespoke-sans: Round-nibbed and commanding, Underdog opens its c like a horseshoe. Bespoke Sans, sharp and refined with generous space between curve ends and stems, would carry paragraph after paragraph without crowding.
gen-dafont-electroharmonix-satoshi: Gappy and striking, it snaps each word into separate, open-handed letters. Electroharmonix earns its keep big and brief, while Satoshi's soaring x-height and wide e keep the rest relaxed.
gen-gf-warnes-fs-asap: Stretched, spacious and tapered, Warnes draws ink strokes of one width that fade out before touching. Asap follows with readable, open-arc text whose body height nearly matches its capitals.
gen-gf-autour-one-general-sans: Round and bold, Autour One opens a clear channel into each curve without any hairline shift. And General Sans matches that with a smooth path around every bend, its x-height filling the line.
